# Reference fixtures

`typescript-v2.35.0.json` is generated by `tools/reference/generate.mjs` against the pinned npm package. Timestamps are removed; document values and filtering are compared. This covers a small logger scenario, not the complete upstream contract. Run `npm ci --ignore-scripts` and `npm run fixtures` from `tools/reference` to regenerate it.

`parity-v2.35.0.json` is generated by `npm run fixtures:logger:parity` from
`tools/reference`. Its 48 scenarios execute the actual pinned Logger for child
attribute inheritance, shallow empty-field cleanup and trace-aware buffering.
Checkpoints serialize getters immediately so subsequent mutations of a returned
nested value do not change earlier observations. The clock is fixed for exact
UTF-8 buffer-capacity boundaries. Record comparisons remove only timestamps and
project overflow errors to their message; Go error names, stacks and locations
remain intentional native differences. Root/descendant replacer ordering,
custom map-shaped formatter envelopes, eviction, missing traces, child buffers
and disabled automatic error flushing are included. This is a scoped corpus,
not complete Logger parity.
